sources.citation: Knappert, S. C. 1905. Beschrijving van de Onderafdeeling Koetei. Bijdragen tot de Taal-, Land- en Volkenkunde van Nederlandsch-Indië 58: 575-654 (DOI 10.1163/22134379-90001995). Ampanang material at pp. 590 and 615-616.
sources.note: Nothing. It is a colonial administrative description of Kutai; the Ampanang content is one remark (p. 590) that the people of Ampanang speak 'een afzonderlijk dialect' and a 19-word Dutch-Ampanang list plus the autonym 'Behasa Ampanang' (pp. 615-616), in Dutch orthography (ĕ = schwa, é = close e; no stress marks), with the note that only the old still know it and the young mix it with Kutai and Malay. No phonological or prosodic statement of any kind.
